save.text: Sam absent; Scanlan to be Jaeger-piloted by Keyleth and Percy; Pike still in New York; Patrick Rothfuss (Kerrek) joining via Skype.

Sponsor: Lootcrate returned; January theme ‘origins’; brands: Superman, Marvel, TMNT, Nintendo; order cutoff 9PM tonight; URL lootcrate.com/criticalrole; promo code ‘criticalrole’ for 10% off first month.
Shout-out: Blue Microphones provided new gear; Matt uses Blue; site bluemic.com.

Merch: New CR socks with ‘How do you want to do this?’ and logo; considering Sox Machina per characters if successful; dice returning soon (this or next month); pins and bracelets limited stock back in store.
Anime Milwaukee attendance: Feb 17–19; guests Matt, Marisha, Travis, Laura; CR panel, signings, VO panels.
Patrick Rothfuss may meet cast in Wisconsin during Anime Milwaukee; dinner suggested; he’ll check calendar.
Recap: Vox Machina defeated Thordak; Raishan escaped with Thordak’s corpse and two eggs via teleport; scrying located her on a southern Lucidian Ocean island—Thordak’s former lair, once Opash’s.
Long rest complete; Scanlan, Percy, and Pike leveled; attunement changes underway; Pike’s 8th-level spell undecided (cleric has full list).
Item shuffling: Vax asked for boots back from Vex; Dragon-slaying sword passed around—Grog interested; found Dwarven Thrower warhammer from hoard but requires dwarf attunement (not usable by Grog).
DM ruling: Belt of Dwarvenkind allows attunement to Dwarven Thrower only while belt remains attuned; removing belt forces hammer unattune.

Attunements shifting: Vax sets Deathwalker’s Ward to necrotic; Grog plans to attune Dwarven Thrower (replacing Bloodaxe), note d8 damage and 20/60 range, disadvantage beyond 20; Reckless cancels disadvantage but grants enemies advantage.
Boots: Boots of Elvenkind don’t require attunement; Pike can wear them but would replace Sprinter’s Boots on sheet; Sprinter’s Boots likely require attunement and swapping in armor is slow.
Deck of Many Things correction: Grog permanently -2 to all saving throws from cursed scimitar effect; removable only by a god-level intervention per Matt.
Grog rejects attuning new Ring of Protection +2 offered by Keyleth; he is full on attunements and declines jewelry.
DM correction: prior mistake acknowledged; curse source expended; sword became inert on contact; -2 saves replaces earlier misread effect.
Pike used 5th-level spell to try to cure Grog’s headache; no effect per Matt.
Kerrek loaned Vax’s Cloak of Displacement and Ring of Invisibility; ring to be returned after dragon fight; ring rules: invisibility ends on remove, attack/cast, or bonus action.
Heroes’ Feast cast by Pike using hoard diamond; effects for party (incl. Trinket, Allura, Kima, Kerrek): immune to fear/poison, +15 max HP, advantage on Wisdom saves.
Heroes’ Feast consumed by party incl. Trinket, Allura, Kima, Kerrek; they arrived early in casting and ate per Matt.
Scrying on a location creates a visible sensor orb detectable by see invisibility; risk of tipping off target.
Travel plan: Use Keyleth’s Transport via Plants (6th) instead of Allura’s Teleport (7th) to conserve higher slot; Allura agreed.
Gate Stone left in Cassandra’s care as emergency return signal; Kima took it to deliver to her.
Kima accepted and donned Elven Boots given by Vex; not her style but took them anyway.
Pre-travel: Vex cast Pass Without a Trace on party before Transport via Plants to Island of Viscan.
Second scry with Allura confirmed trees near Island of Viscan lab; Keyleth targeted one for Transport via Plants.
Matt confirms Pass Without Trace is active; stealth checks made with +10; Kima’s Elven Boots let her keep better roll despite disadvantage.
Trees on Viscan are long-dead/near-petrified for hundreds of years; not recent; no new scarring observed.
Allura researched island: indigenous seafaring people vanished after Opash arrived; island considered cursed; few scavengers return.
Closer to mountain, dead trees become ash; treeline thins; multiple unstable ground patches appear, denser near base.
Patches of darker/damp-looking sand are avoidable 10–15 ft ovals; stepping weight can collapse them.
DM identifies patches as hollow earth: magical-energy-eroded, unstable ground akin to sinkholes; unsafe.
Test: Grog’s thrown rock sits briefly then drops through, leaving a void imprint—confirms collapse risk.
Dead trees died rapidly in place; no blast pattern or lean; death increases nearer the mountain.
Mountain ~600 ft tall, rocky mound; at base, an entrance blocked by a 20–30 ft boulder with many claw-made holes.
Claw holes match a very large dragon; boulder has been placed/pulled repeatedly over years.
Vex uses Primeval Awareness: senses three dragon life forces within ~1 mile, direction of the mountain and below; Matt confirms 1-mile range (not wooded).
Pat (paladin) uses Divine Sense at boulder: detects no celestial/fiend/undead within 60 ft near the rock.
Grog negotiates return of the Deck of Many Things to him; Vex agrees in exchange for Periapt of Wound Closure, with Grog promising not to draw or look, keep deck in pouch.
Trade completed: Grog recovered Deck of Many Things; Vex took Periapt of Wound Closure. Grog failed Perception (6) to notice deception; promises not to look while Vex present.

Keyleth casts Stone Shape (4th) on blocked entrance: creates small hole (<5 ft), not full passage; can reach arm through. Oracle Arrow shows 100 ft dusty, untracked tunnel curving left and descending; silent, dark.
Party planning entry: Considering quiet vs. force. Keyleth may burn another 4th-level to widen; Grog suggests brute force; concern noise may alert Raishan; Percy notes Grog last resort.
Party debates options: second Stone Shape would work to carve chunk; concern about noise from siege gauntlets; leveraging via hole to shift boulder; avoid high-level Bigby.
Vax proposes Oil of Etherealness: enough for one (Scanlan or Pike) to scout through rock; idea acknowledged as risky/limited.
Matt confirms dragon-sized fingerholds; boulder jammed in by something grabbing it; no switches found (Grog inv 17).
Party opens passage: Grog (adv, Pike assist) levers boulder ~1.5 ft; Immovable Rods wedged into claw-holes to hold; group squeezes in; boulder now stationary and wedged shut.
Matt confirms dragon-sized fingerholds; boulder jammed by something grabbing it; Immovable Rods each hold 8,000 lbs; rods wedged into holes hold the boulder for now.
Inside tunnel: 15 ft wide, 12 ft tall; dusty, still air, rot/stagnant water smell; rough but intentional carving; scattered charred bone shards on floor.
Bones in tunnel are years old or longer; dust layer shows untouched for a while; ties to Thordak’s lair era.
Group restelts: stealth results high (range ~18–35); proceeding quietly down mildly descending curving tunnel.
Pike casts Death Ward (4th level) on Vex; lasts 8 hours; Vex pops to 1 HP if dropped to 0.
Percy and Kerrek lack darkvision; Vax lights Flametongue Dagger to provide light for Kerrek.
Flametongue dagger light is candle-level; with dagger out Vax gets effective bright vision to 60 ft, without it only ~15 ft dim; party opts to extinguish for stealth, guiding Percy/Kerrek by arm.
Tunnel features crafted shelves/alcoves every ~20 ft holding melted candles, a humanoid skull, small books, a small wooden box (not trapped per Vax, left), and a mummified raccoon-like creature.
Vax actively searches for traps; with dagger light, normal checks; finds no traps so far (Inv 18); proceeds cautiously.
Kerrek uses Divine Sense: detects an undead presence nearby; later corrected to know type/location if not behind total cover; senses it to the left from a wall area.
Vax continues trap search; Investigation 25 finds no traps; notes ancient stonework/slabs amid collapsed, avoids worked sections.
Left wall shelf holds two mostly melted candles and a human skull (slightly singed/sooty); Grog hands skull to Kerrek; undead presence likely linked to shelf/skull.
Kerrek reuses Divine Sense; Matt confirms the skull is the undead source; it’s inert while held.
Skull handled: Kerrek sacks the skull and sets it back on the shelf facing the wall; party opts not to destroy it.
Marching order: Twins front; behind them Grog & Kerrek, then Keyleth & Percy, then Ash & Scanlan; rear Kima & Allura with Trinket.
Keyleth lights fire hands, granting torchlight; Kerrek and Percy can now see room features incl. iron bowl on pillar, large iron door opposite, brazier and lone tome on right wall.
Vex investigates iron bowl: finds long-dried liquid residue; scraping yields dark burgundy powder tasting of iron—identified as old blood; suggests bleeding into bowl may open door.
Room details: ancient stone chamber; no ceiling gaps or visible mechanisms; opposite is a smooth-seamed large iron door; no levers/panels; debris from age/cave-ins.
Lone tome on right wall resists reading: any viewer sees text shrink/blur to illegible; brighter light makes pages go nearly blank; title also obscures.
Allura adventuring with party first time; Kerrek’s warhammer emits radiant-light head when activated; bright light warms air, repels mustiness.
Plan shift: extinguish all lights so someone with darkvision/low-light can try reading the book; hammer light switched off.
Book was a trapped decoy: lighting brazier detonated flammable liquids; blast destroyed the book; Allura deduced its purpose was a trap.
Iron bowl ritual test: basilisk blood poured—no effect; Vex then cuts her hand to add her own blood hoping to open the iron door.
Brazier explosion: Dex save DC unknown; Kerrek and Keyleth failed (32 fire); others nearby took 16 (Vax evaded). Door remained closed; room lit again; brazier ruined.
Vex’s blood in basilisk blood triggers the mechanism: bowl glows, basilisk blood burns to edges, door lifts open; Vex takes 1 dmg.

After door opens, four flame skulls (two each direction) approach amid cackling lights; Pike casts Holy Aura (30-ft radius, adv on saves; enemies have disadv; fiends/undead melee Con save or blinded).
Initiative rolled vs four flame skulls: top order includes Scanlan 22 (nat 20), Keyleth 22 (nat 20), Vax 21, Percy 17, Vex 16, Grog 14.
Initiative specifics added: Pike 9; Kerrek 1 (last). Scanlan and Vax act first this round.

Combat starts: Four flame skulls (two each side). Scanlan casts Invisibility (2nd level) and backs to north wall; Vax flies 10 ft up, throws Whisper and venom dagger hitting one skull (total 29 dmg incl. 19+10).
Keyleth casts Moonbeam (5-ft radius) positioned to hit two skulls; both fail Con saves and take 13 radiant; one skull near-falling, flames flickering.
All four flame skulls cast Fireball; DC 13 Dex save with advantage; damage totals ruled: save all = 56 fire, fail two = 88, etc.

Dex saves vs four Fireballs: Scanlan excluded (invisible). Saves: Vax all (Evasion=0); Percy all (takes 56); Keyleth all; Vex all; Kerrek all; Grog failed two (takes 88); Pike failed two (44 after fire resist); Trinket saved one and is in necklace.
Percy kills two flame skulls with Animus using Sharpshooter/Deadeye; gains grit back on each kill; moves to perch on wall.

Kerrek’s Aura of Protection (+3 to saves) applies: retroactively changes results—Grog’s two 10s become 13s, so he saved all four (takes 56 total); Pike also benefited on one (refund 11 fire dmg). Trinket still failed three even with +3.
